key_requirements: Appoint DPO (thresholds); notify breaches to Commissioner and data subjects; data portability; processor security duties
enforcement_authority: Personal Data Protection Commissioner / Department of Personal Data Protection (JPDP)
penalties_range: Up to RM1,000,000 fine and/or up to 3 years' imprisonment
deceased_data: Not covered: 2024 Amendment Act excludes personal data of deceased individuals from scope (in force 1 Apr 2025)
research_exemption: Exemption for data processed for statistics or research, results not identifying individuals (s. 45); further exemptions by Minister (s. 46) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: No specific rule: genetic data not named; biometric data added to sensitive personal data by 2024 amendment (explicit consent) (unconfirmed)
notes: Amended by PDP (Amendment) Act 2024, phased in during 2025 (DPO, breach notice, RM1M fines)
